artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is an ornate engraving with a partial view of the upper body of a young man, framed within an oval medallion. The young man is identified as Henricus (Henry), Prince of Wales, with well-defined facial features and short, neatly styled hair. He wears elaborate clothing typical of the era, with a high, ruffled collar and decorative armor suggesting nobility or high status. Above the medallion, two cherubs hold an escutcheon, with another cherub on each side engaging in varied activities. Flanking the medallion are two female figures. One is dressed as an armored warrior with a plumed helmet and holding a spear, while the other is in flowing classical robes, reminiscent of Roman or Greek attire. The background features a draped curtain setup, enhancing the grandeur of the scene. Beneath the medallion, a Latin inscription is on a decorated pedestal.

artworks.title: Martin Billingsley
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the waist up, seated with one shoulder angled slightly forward. His face is turned towards the viewer, displaying pronounced facial features, including a pointed mustache and a tuft of hair styled upwards in the front. The man has short hair surrounding the tuft and appears to be in a formal setting. His attire includes a doublet typical of the early 17th century, featuring a high, elaborate lace collar, and he holds a quill pen delicately poised in one hand against a small writing desk. Surrounding the portrait is a decorative border with Latin text, and beneath it, there is a section containing printed English text that praises the art of writing. The intricate background consists of fine lines and decorative scrollwork that frame the central image, creating the impression of a formal and historically styled portrait.

artworks.title: Thomas Egerton, First Viscount Brackley
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man shown from the chest up, facing forward. The man has a pointed beard, mustache, expressive eyes, and a high forehead. He wears a tall, rounded hat with a decorative band, formal clothing with a ruffled collar, an intricately patterned doublet, and a fur-lined cloak. The portrait is surrounded by an oval border with Latin text and the background features fine lines and shading for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: George Chapman
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved portrait of a man focusing on his head and shoulders. The man's face features a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a well-defined nose, full beard, and mustache. His curly hair is styled away from his face. The man is not wearing visible clothing. A round frame surrounds the portrait, with Latin text and decorative elements. The background has engravings and text below the portrait. The design is characterized by classical and formal detailing typical of historical portrait engravings.

artworks.title: Michael Drayton
artworks.description: It is an engraved portrait of a man. He is positioned facing forward, with his gaze slightly to the side. He has defined cheekbones, a prominent nose, and a neatly trimmed goatee. His hair is wavy and medium in length, styled back from his face, and he wears a laurel wreath. The man is adorned in a traditional garment typical of the Renaissance period with a high lace collar and decorative vertical buttoning down the front of his doublet. The background includes an ornate oval frame with an inscription around it, set against a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Michael Drayton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up, seated and facing forward. The person has a serious expression with distinctive facial features, including a mustache and a goatee. Their hair is short, curly, and brown, adorned with a laurel wreath. The clothing is formal and elaborate, consisting of a buttoned coat with detailed embroidery on the edges and a wide, white collar. The person is surrounded by an oval frame, which features an inscription describing the person. The background outside the frame is ornate and includes intricate designs, while there is additional text below the portrait in a stylized script.

artworks.title: John Florio
artworks.description: The image shows the upper-body of a man within an ornate oval frame. He faces forward with a slight turn to his right, looking at the viewer. The man has detailed facial features, a mustache, a goatee, and wavy hair styled back. He wears clothing typical of the early 17th century, including a doublet, fur-lined cloak, and a pleated ruff. The oval is surrounded by decorative foliage, a sun emblem at the top, and inscriptions in Latin. The background features elegant leaf patterns.

artworks.title: John Florio
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man depicted from the chest up in an ornate and historical style. The man is facing slightly to the right, with a direct gaze forward. He has a styled face with sharp features, a short beard and mustache. His hair is short and curly, neatly arranged around his head. He wears elaborate clothing typical of the period, including a ruffled collar and a detailed coat with fur trim. The background features an intricate pattern with decorative elements, including floral motifs. An ornate emblem is above his head, and there is text surrounding him and at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Prince Henry With the Pike
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person standing in a confident pose. The individual is holding a long staff horizontally with both arms extended, with the right hand near the waist and the left hand fully stretched outwards. The person has wavy hair styled upward and back. They are adorned in an elaborate outfit resembling armor with detailed patterns, a high, lacy collar, and a short, pleated skirt, complete with leggings and shoes adorned with decorative puffs. The person also wears a knee band and a sword or dagger is attached to the right hip. The background comprises a simple, plain setting, emphasizing the figure, with a helmet placed on a tuft of plumes on the ground to the left. The illustration is monochromatic with finely-etched lines.

artworks.title: Prince Henry With the Pike
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a fencing stance, with his upper body facing right. He has curly hair, an aquiline nose, high cheekbones, pursed lips, and is wearing ornate armor with intricate designs. He is holding a rapier with both hands, wearing decorative shoes and a garter on his right leg. Plumes and a helmet are on the ground near him. The background is plain with the inscription "HENRICVS PRINCEPS" above a faint horizontal line.

artworks.title: Prince Henry's Hearse
artworks.description: The image depicts a person lying on their back on a platform with a canopy supported by columns. The person has their head turned slightly to the side, wearing a crown and a detailed robe with fur or a decorative collar. There are pillows under their head, a shield with a coat of arms nearby, and grand architectural elements in the background.

artworks.title: George Wither
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in historical attire, featuring his upper body with a frontal facing posture. The man has distinctive facial features, including a well-maintained mustache and short, wavy hair. He is dressed in elaborate clothing typical of the late Renaissance period, with a detailed doublet and a large lace ruff around his neck. The man holds gloves in one hand and rests the other hand on his hip. He is framed by a circular border with text stating "I GROW AND WITHER BOTH TOGETHER" and his age as 21. The background has a simple, textured pattern, and there is additional text at the bottom, possibly a poetic passage.

artworks.title: Text from Drayton's Poly-olbion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate manuscript page with decorative elements and text. The drawing features two intricately designed borders at the top and bottom of the page, filled with elaborate scrollwork, foliage, and a stylized emblem in the center. The central portion of the page is dominated by printed text, with a large decorative initial letter "T" commencing the section. The text itself appears to be written in an older style of English. The left margin contains additional explanatory notes in smaller print. The overall appearance suggests a historical document emphasizing themes of power and lineage.

artworks.title: Frontispiece to Drayton's Poly-olbion
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an allegorical title page for a publication. The central figure is draped in a map-adorned robe, holding a scepter and a cornucopia, with laurel leaves on their head. Surrounding figures are in armor, with classical architectural elements like columns and statues. In the background, a boat is on the sea. The titles "POLY-OLBION" and "GREAT BRITAINE" are displayed prominently. Ornate borders and floral designs frame the image, with a cherub at the top. At the bottom, a banner attributes the work to Michael Drayton.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes, Bishop of Winchester
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated, facing slightly to the left. He has distinct facial features, wearing a cap and a dark robe with a high white collar. He is holding a book in his left hand, with his right hand resting on top of it. The background features an oval frame with Latin text and decorative motifs, along with a block of printed text below the portrait. The image is rendered in an etching style.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated and turned slightly to the right, with a solemn expression. He has distinctive facial features, a mustache, and wears period-appropriate clothing, including a robe with a pleated ruff. He holds a closed book, with one finger between the pages. The portrait is surrounded by a circular frame with text, and below it, there is an emblem and inscribed text. The background features engraved linework providing a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes
artworks.description: The engraving shows a waist-up portrait of a man seated. He wears a dark academic-style cap, with short hair visible. His facial features suggest an older man with pronounced cheekbones and focused eyes looking downward. He is dressed in formal ecclesiastical clothing, including a ruffled white collar and voluminous sleeves, with a robe draped over his shoulders. He holds an open book with his fingers as if turning a page. The setting is within an ornate oval border with engraved text and decorative embellishments. The background features intricate line work.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes
artworks.description: The image includes an engraving of a man sitting, holding a book in front of him. He has a solemn expression and distinct facial features: a prominent brow, a long nose, and a mustache with a short beard. He wears a dark beret, a clerical robe with a high, ruffled white collar, loose sleeves, and a white shirt visible at the collar and cuffs. The background features a circular ornate border with an inscription around the man, along with text and a coat of arms. The image is monochromatic with detailed line work characteristic of engravings from that time.

artworks.title: Lancelot Andrewes
artworks.description: The image shows a man in clerical attire with short hair, a mustache, and a pointed beard. He is seated with his body turned slightly to the left, holding a book. The background is an oval frame with inscriptions surrounding the portrait. The text below the image indicates the man's identity and age.

artworks.title: Reverend Robert Bolton
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an older man in an ornate oval frame. The man has facial hair, a full white beard, and mustache. He is wearing a dark, buttoned garment with a high collar and a wide decorative collar. The frame is decorated with floral motifs and scrolls. Above the oval frame, there is a small vase with a feather. The background has a textured pattern, and there is inscribed text, a signature, and a date below the portrait.

artworks.title: Rev. Robert Bolton
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of Robert Bolton from the waist up. He is facing slightly left but looking directly at the viewer. Bolton has an oval-shaped face with a full beard and mustache, short and neatly combed back hair. He is dressed in a high-collared garment under a cloak-like outerwear. A broad collar is visible at the neckline. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background features an oval frame separating his figure from the text, detailing his life and achievements. Text at the top and bottom of the image provides information about "The Life of Robert Bolton" and his biography.

artworks.title: Robert Bolton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in formal clothing. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has an aged face with distinct features such as a full white beard and mustache, deeply set eyes, and light hair with a receding hairline. He is wearing a dark, textured garment with a high collar typical of historical clothing. The background is plain. Text in the lower portion identifies him as "Robert Bolton, Batchelour in divinity & minister of Gods word att Broughton in Northamptonshire."

artworks.title: Hugh Broughton
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is standing and facing forward with his eyes looking at the viewer. The man has sharp facial features, including prominent cheekbones, a beard, and short, combed-back hair. He is dressed in period attire, wearing a dark robe with broad shoulders and a detailed ruffled lace collar around his neck. The man's hands are in front of him, holding a small book or booklet. The engraving includes decorative elements like scrolling ribbons and trumpets in the corners. There is bold, stylized text around the man's head. The background features intricate lines and patterns typical of engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Christian, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person within an oval frame. The individual is depicted from the chest up, looking directly at the viewer. They have distinct facial features, including a long nose and sharp eyes, with curly hair. The person is wearing formal clothing with a lace collar and decorative mantle. The oval frame is adorned with intricate designs, including cherubic figures, musical instruments, and scrolls, indicating scholarly or musical themes. The bottom of the engraving features text detailing the subject's titles and lineage. The background is textured.
